sections.note: Scroll position alone decides which two shapes the dots are between, so every morph reverses as you scroll back.
Where the open lens is on screen, shared so the dots can pack themselves into its circle.
Words rise out of their masks one after another: a few lines of code, and no animation library.
The letters of a heading lift in a wave as the cursor passes.
Each piece rises in the first time it comes into view, and never watches again.
One animation loop for the whole page: the timeline, the toolkit line and every canvas take their turn in it.
The circle you have just been moving around.
The fill floods in from the exact point the cursor enters.
Both clocks are worked out from the time zones themselves, daylight saving included.

sections.from: // Leaving the portrait, and writing the footer name
sections.note: The name is written by the same dots that drew the portrait: a mist that condenses into letters.

services.from: // `count` dots, each somewhere on the paint

work.from: // Everything takes off from where it is now
work.note: Whatever the dots were on their way to, they take off from exactly where they are now.
